S110.01.note: The Edit and save controls were found; the version list label was not confirmed.
steps: Ask the assistant in chat to write a document, for example a short memo, and wait for it to finish.
Open the document artifact from the chat.
Click the Edit button (aria-label "Edit document").
Change some text in the document.
Click the save control (title "Save as a new version").
Look for the new version in the artifact's version controls and compare with Expected: the edit is saved back as a new version.
S110.01.where: Open a chat answer that holds a document > open the document as an artifact > Edit document

S110.12.needs: a design file and a repository
S110.12.note: Searched apps/web/features/code and apps/web/lib/e2b/gate.ts. The feature depends on AGI_E2B_EXECUTION and E2B_API_KEY. No visible label for a design-to-implementation flow was found.

S110.14.note: The draft card label 'Save as a skill' is in apps/web/features/chat/components/PluginDraftCard.tsx. The settings path to the skills list was not confirmed.
steps: Finish a task in chat so the answer is complete.
Click the More message actions button on that answer.
Click Save as skill.
Look at the plugin draft card and confirm the skill is saved.
Open the skills list in settings and check that the skill appears, compared with Expected.
S110.14.where: Chat > the answer's More message actions menu > Save as skill

S110.18.needs: a signed-in account on web and the phone app
S110.18.note: The effect is in the sync and persistence routes (apps/web/app/api/chat/sync/route.ts and persist-message.ts), not a control of its own.
steps: Start a chat in the web app and send a message.
Open the same conversation on the phone app and check that the full history is there.
Send a follow-up from the phone.
Reload the web app and check that the reply appears in the same conversation.
S110.18.where: Web chat sidebar and the phone app's conversation list

S110.23.note: Found apps/web/lib/e2b/gate.ts. The feature depends on AGI_E2B_EXECUTION and E2B_API_KEY. No visible label for bringing a cloud result into a local checkout was found.

S110.24.note: A chat is scoped to a project or a local folder, never both, per the comment in WebChatPage.
steps: Open the main chat.
Click the Project or folder control in the composer.
Search for or pick an existing project.
Ask a question that the project's sources should answer.
Check that the answer uses the project's sources, compared with Expected.
S110.24.where: Chat > composer > Project or folder > pick the project

S110.25.note: Artifacts also have a 'Save to project' group in apps/web/features/chat/components/artifacts/ArtifactPreview.tsx. The project list in the project was not confirmed.
steps: Open a chat with a finished answer.
Click the More message actions button on the answer.
Click Save to project.
Pick the project name from the list.
Open that project and check that the answer is listed as a source, compared with Expected.
S110.25.where: Chat > an answer's More message actions > Save to project > pick the project

S110.26.needs: an account that has run out of usage
S110.26.note: The 'Switch to' label is a template string in the same file, and the exact trigger was not reproduced.
steps: Use up the account's usage, or use an account that is already out of usage.
Send a new message in chat.
Look at the inline card that appears under the message.
Click Switch to (the named model) to continue, or Buy credits.
Check that the reply continues, compared with Expected.
S110.26.where: Chat > send a message after the usage limit is reached > inline card

S110.28.note: The settings navigation label was not confirmed.
steps: Publish an artifact with the Publish button in the artifact panel.
Edit the artifact and publish again to the same link.
Open Settings and find the Published artifacts section.
Click History on the artifact row.
Check that the new version is listed and can be restored, compared with Expected.

labels.text: Save a copy to my chats

S110.29.needs: a second account and a shared artifact link
S110.29.note: The label comes from a translation key with this fallback text. The continue-chat page is apps/web/app/chat/from-share/[token]/page.tsx.
steps: Sign in with a second account.
Open a shared artifact link from the first account.
Click Save a copy to my chats.
Open the copy in your own chats.
Continue the copy and check that it is private to your account, compared with Expected.
S110.29.where: Shared artifact link > Save a copy to my chats

S110.30.needs: a second member in the same workspace
S110.30.note: The route from the sidebar to the workspace console was not confirmed. Access labels Can view and Can edit are in apps/web/features/projects/components/ProjectSharingControls.tsx.
steps: Open the workspace console and click Sharing.
Or open a project, artifact or chat and click Share, then Share with workspace.
Pick an access level, such as Can view or Can edit.
Sign in as another member and open the shared resource.
Check the member can find and open it, compared with Expected.
